description: This file defines an 'Activity' controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard, handling display, saving settings, and rendering activity feeds.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class for displaying and managing activity feed in Opencart dashboard.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes dashboard view, loads language strings, sets up breadcrumbs, and prepares data for rendering activity form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes save request for activity dashboard settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates activity feed view by fetching recent activities and formatting them for display.
